title: A group module named in extensions.backlog_commands adds a backlog.py command or replaces a shipped one through bl_cli.register, and backlog.py -h marks it as the group's
goal: backlog.py imports each module that the settings layers' extensions.backlog_commands lists (resolved with kbext, KBEXT_REQUIRES checked) after the shipped ones; its bl_cli.register or bl_cli.extend calls add a command or replace a shipped one of the same name, which prints one stderr line naming the command, the module and the layer each time it runs. backlog.py -h lists a group command with the group name in its help. A module that fails to load is named on stderr and the shipped commands run as before, exit codes unchanged. extending.md names bl_cli.register, bl_cli.extend and the handler's signature as the point's contract.

run:
import json,subprocess,sys,tempfile,pathlib
d=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); subprocess.run(["git","init","-q",str(d)],check=True); e=d/"ext"; e.mkdir(); (d/"items").mkdir()
(d/"backlog.json").write_text(json.dumps({"item_dir":"items"}),encoding="utf-8")
(e/"grp_cmd.py").write_text("import bl_cli\nKBEXT_REQUIRES = \">=1.0,<2\"\ndef hello(args):\n    print(\"planted hello\")\n    return 0\nbl_cli.register(\"hello\", hello, help=\"say hello (group)\")\n",encoding="utf-8")
(d/"settings.json").write_text(json.dumps({"group":"grp","extensions":{"backlog_commands":["grp_cmd"]},"extension_paths":["ext"]}),encoding="utf-8")
b=lambda *a: subprocess.run([sys.executable,"_tools/backlog.py","--root",str(d),*a],capture_output=True,text=True)
r=b("hello"); assert r.returncode==0 and "planted hello" in r.stdout, (r.stdout,r.stderr)
r=b("-h"); assert r.returncode==0 and "hello" in r.stdout, r.stdout[-800:]
r=b("list"); assert r.returncode in (0,1), r.stderr
